definitions.full: H6348. pachaz [ מָּחַז ] verb be wanton, reckless (Late Hebrew id. (rare); Arabic be haughty, boastful, reckless ; מְּחַז ᵑ7 , Syriac be lascivious , in derived species and derivatives ); — Qal Participle וּפֹחֲזִים רֵיקִים אֲנָשִׁים Judg 9:4 ; of prophets Zeph 3:4 extravagant (|| בֹּגְדוֺת אַנְשֵׁי ).
